description:
As a Salesforce Platform Engineer, you are a technical expert that will independently identify, engineer, and optimize Salesforce technology solutions that address critical business needs. Continuously seeking to improve existing methods and processes. Read and adapt literature and publicly available information to accomplish assignments. Demonstrate proficiency in a broad range of techniques and methods for information technology engineering, including software development, data warehousing, statistics, machine learning, and/or technology. Technology Engineers will be aligned to a specific area: Information, Software, Data, or Infrastructure. 
 Responsibilities: 
 Understand, design, implement, demonstrate, and deploy Salesforce Technology solutions using Point and click OOO features, Apex, Triggers, LWC, REST/SOAP integrations by studying Business needs, futuristic use cases, system data flows, work processes, investigating the production problems. 
 Analyze and resolve technical problems using analytical problem-solving techniques/methods. 
 Conduct estimation, design, and code reviews, identify system or process or solution gaps, and construct or provide recommendations for corrective actions. 
 Create design models, best practices for vendors and other staff members to follow. 
 Study the Salesforce Release Notes and bring the PoV on new features that can be incorporated into system and business processes. 
 Conduct POC for the new features, document, and demonstrate the observations and learnings, construct the Business Use Case, cost estimation, and execution plan for them. 
 Highly autonomous and productive in performing activities, requiring minimal direction from the Supervisor. 
 Construct the Technical specifications and technical design documents. 
 Provide technical leadership and mentor and consult vendors or less experienced staff in planning, procedures, and best practices. 
 Work with Product Owners, Solution Architects, Application Architects for new projects and maintain good relationships with cross functional teams. 
 Understand and adhere to corporate standards regarding applicable Corporate and Divisional Policies, including code of conduct, safety, GxP compliance, data security, and the software development lifecycle. 
 Understand the broad objectives of the project as well as your role in achieving those objectives and modify approach when required. Escalate open issues to ensure execution success and keep stakeholders informed through effective verbal and written communication. 
 Learn, understand, and master new methods and technologies, and act as a resource or mentor for others. 
 Effectively organize and present project objectives and progress. Contribute to technical publications and presentations. 
 Obtain estimates/quotes from vendors and provide as input into overall project time and cost estimates. 
 Maintain relationships with affiliates, subsidiaries, and vendors in accordance with AbbVie Values, Vendor Management Office, and Purchasing to further the mission, vision, and goals of the organization. 
 Produce and maintain required technical documentation associated with work products. 
 Understand and adhere to corporate standards regarding applicable Corporate and Divisional Policies, including code of conduct, safety, GxP compliance, data security, and the software development lifecycle. 
 
 Required: 
 Bachelor’s Degree in relevant field with 5 years of relevant experience; Master’s Degree with 4 years of experience. 
 Must have respective years of experience of each of the following:  Salesforce administration and development experience. 
 Designing & implementing new processes & facilitating user adoption. 
 Identifying & analyzing upstream & downstream impact analysis through applications, systems, & processes. 
 Building custom applications with triggers/Apex code/Aura/LWC/SOAP/REST Integration; Flows, Platform Events. 
 Writing SOQL/SOSL & SQL with any RDBMS (e.g., SQL Server/Oracle/DB2) 
 Exp may be gained concurrently.
 Salesforce.com Administrator certification. 
 Salesfroce.com Platform Developer I 
 Salesfroce.com Platform Developer II
